name: Zorph Muffet
original_name: ズオルフ・マフェット
source:
The owner of hidden rich men's planet Shangri La and a central figure of the Red Planax, anti-Japanese union. He may be the richest man in the whole Universe. The main thing on the world to him is a money, the second is a dispelling his boredom. Has plans to rule all the Universe with the power of money. Want to implement "Ideal Economic Aesthetic" in the world.

"The rich ones will become richer, the poor ones will become poorer!"
